items.title: Labarbera interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2021
items.q: I’ve put in Gil Evans’s “My Ship,” I put that in Finale... She studied with... Gil Evans

ctx.x: That’s for sure. But can you tell if using Finale has changed the way you write?

No it hasn’t. As a matter of fact when I was teaching, I just retired a few years ago, I would make it a point to all my students that you cannot use the playback of Finale or Sibelius or any of those. Do not listen to the playback. If you listen to a playback make everything piano. Because you’re going to get fooled because the instrument has no overtones. I’ve put in, just as an example for the kids, I’ve put in Thad Jones’s “Quietitude” I put that in Finale, I put in Gil Evans’s “My Ship,” I put that in…
Plus the opportunities to sit in a big band and absorb all that information over the years is not there like it was unless you’re in an educational school —
